Typical tasks

Dashboards we build

  • Sales

    Revenue, quotes, order intake and pipeline by customer, region or product.

  • Production and quality

    Inspection results, complaints, scrap and delivery reliability over time.

  • Finance and controlling

    Costs, margins and liquidity compared with plan and previous year.

  • Projects

    Status, budget and deadlines of all projects on one page.

  • Management overview

    The company's most important figures for management and board.

  • Automatic reports

    Weekly or monthly summaries by email, with AI commentary on anything unusual.

FAQ

Answers up front

Which systems can data come from?

Excel and CSV, common ERP and CRM systems, databases and many cloud services with an API.

Who can see the dashboard?

Only authorised people. Access is protected by login, with different views per role on request.

How often is the data updated?

Depending on the source: hourly, daily or close to real time.

Do we need an expensive BI tool?

No. We build the dashboard as a web application, with no ongoing licence fees per user.
